name: foray-passage-index
description: Stream indexer and passage index (GV-09 onward, docs/roadmap/generation-v2.md): builds the per-show BM25 caches, the episode manifest, staged digest rows and passages from local bodies or the R2 normalized objects, one body in memory at a time. No dependencies of its own: it reuses tools/foraycorpus-export (R2 client, sync rules, show map, disk guard), whose AWS SDK import is lazy, and spawns the backend indexBodies CLI through backend/node_modules' tsx. Writes only under data-local/.
//test: Same contract as tools/corpus and tools/foraycorpus-export: tools/ci/run-suites.mjs invokes this as `npm test -- <files>`, so the script MUST end in `node --test` and forward its arguments (with none, node --test discovers from this directory). --experimental-sqlite is here for the passage store that later cards add (node:sqlite is flagged on Node 22.x). stream-index.test.mjs asserts the forwarding.
